game_concept: A tower defense set in Coastal Port – Fish Market, a fish market full of crates: the shipwright must handle jellyfish swarms while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – And/Or Locks: Combine conditions with and/or to open a lock that needs several clues.
theme: Coastal Port – Fish Market: a fish market full of crates
core_gameplay_loop: In Fish Market, repeat each round: Combine conditions with and/or to open a lock that needs several clues. Each round, jellyfish swarms strike the ferry, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the lock_progress value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the ferry from jellyfish swarms in Fish Market: keep the lock_progress meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 30-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lock_progress drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 30-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 1 (intro tier): And/Or Locks
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'And/Or Locks' (Week 3 slot 4), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Fish Market'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how lock_progress changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against jellyfish swarms in Fish Market.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 30 seconds while lock_progress > 0.
